name: Jellyfin Federation
overview: Allows jellyfin servers to federate with each other
description: This Jellyfin plugin allows multiple Jellyfin servers to federate, sharing media libraries in real-time without syncing or copying files. Media can be streamed from one server to another with live transcoding if necessary.

versions.changelog: Pairing codes (beta, off by default) and security hardening. Pairing: for servers that can't be port-forwarded, two admins swap two short codes and compare a safety number by voice; the servers then connect over an encrypted UDP link with no open ports, tunnel or Tailscale, and reconnect on their own. Off until you tick it on the new Beta tab, which gathers the sensitive beta settings (direct links, pairing, adaptive playback) with an explanation of each; a paired friend sees this home's internet address. Hardening for direct links: a friend's requests now reach your Jellyfin with only the headers the link needs (no proxy or client-address headers), and read-ahead ignores oversized playlists. Both were found in an attack review; neither was known to be exploitable. Larger QUIC windows for friends far away. Includes everything in 0.0.197.
